headline: Elevation 627 vs 617 m: measured residual near zero; the 'not a datum conflict' reading depends on an assumed tile centre.
grade_rule: weakest of its atomic parts (C > L > S)

parts.statement: Median of EPQS minus (617 + DSM) is +0.03 m over 140 points at 30 m spacing.
Ground across the 400 x 300 m tile spans 619.8 to 632.9 m in EPQS, so 627.175 m is one point on the slope.
The tile centre (37.2284, -80.4234) and z-southward orientation are assumptions (correlation 0.51 vs -0.40).
Therefore 627 vs 617 m is not a datum conflict: 617 m is the right reference for the DSM.
